message: FORGE-BOARD-2.2 requires pr_ready to archive .factory/grills/tasks/, but factory/scripts/pr_ready.py owns that archive and is outside the declared write scope; add it to scope or move the acceptance criterion to a stage that owns it.

notes: Confirmed — pr_ready.py is correctly OUT of scope for 2.2. Implement only require_task_grill + the cmd_delegate gate + its tests within the declared write_scope (factory_lib.py, delegate.py, test_gates.py). Drop the pr_ready-archiving acceptance criterion from this stage; the grills/tasks/ archiving in pr_ready is deferred to a follow-up (the contract was mis-scoped upfront — the exact failure JIT planning prevents). Do NOT touch pr_ready.py.
